# 9ineflix

## What is 9ineflix?
9ineflix is a free online streaming discovery platform where users can watch movies, TV shows, and anime.
It uses The Movie Database (TMDB) API for metadata and streams content via embedded third-party players.

## Sitemap
- Homepage: https://9ineflix.com
- Movies: https://9ineflix.com/movies
- TV Shows: https://9ineflix.com/tv-shows
- Anime: https://9ineflix.com/anime
- New & Popular: https://9ineflix.com/new-popular
- Search: https://9ineflix.com/search
- Watch History: https://9ineflix.com/history
- About: https://9ineflix.com/about
- Privacy Policy: https://9ineflix.com/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://9ineflix.com/terms

## Key Features
- Browse trending movies, top-rated films, and new releases
- Watch TV shows with season and episode selectors
- Anime catalog with Japanese animation content
- Search across all media types
- Local watch history stored in browser
- Mobile-friendly responsive design

## Technical Stack
- Next.js 16 (App Router)
- TypeScript
- Framer Motion for animations
- TMDB API for movie/show metadata
- Third-party embed player (vidsrc.me)

## Content Policy
9ineflix does not host any content. All streams are embedded from third-party sources.
The platform aggregates publicly available streaming links for educational and discovery purposes.
